title: Spec Workflow Iteration (Current Sprint) State
description: Persistent view of the current iteration/sprint: which OpenSpec changes are proposed/in-worktree/completed/archived, their blocker relationships, and current task progress. Stored at .rddf/state/iteration.json.

version.description: Schema version. v3: added 'planned' status to changes.

current_phase.description: Current roadmap phase (e.g. 'v2.1'). May be 'default' or 'unknown' in compat mode.

changes.description: One entry per OpenSpec change ever observed in the current iteration. Archived changes are kept (not deleted) for history.

name.description: OpenSpec change name (directory name under openspec/changes/).

phase.description: Roadmap phase this change belongs to. From roadmap-meta.yaml.

category.description: Roadmap category within the phase. From roadmap-meta.yaml.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Updated by propose/guide-ship/execute/archive hooks. 'planned' = skeleton change (only .openspec.yaml + roadmap-meta.yaml + minimal proposal.md), not yet eligible for guide-ship.

added_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the change was first added to iteration.

worktree_path.description: Path to worktree (e.g. '.rddf/wt/<name>'). Set when status transitions to in_worktree.

plan_path.description: Path to Prometheus plan (e.g. '.rddf/plans/<name>.md'). Set when plan is generated.

tasks_done.description: Number of completed tasks in tasks.md. Updated by execute hook.

tasks_total.description: Total number of tasks. Snapshot at plan generation; not auto-updated when tasks.md is edited.

blocker.description: Name of the change that hard-blocks this one (from deps). Null if ready or no deps run yet.

parallel_group.description: Topological layer from deps. Changes in the same group can run in parallel.

conflicts.description: Change names with file-level conflicts. Empty array if no deps run yet.

last_deps_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last deps run that updated blocker/group/conflicts.

archived_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when status transitioned to archived.

parent_feature.description: Name of the parent feature/epic this change belongs to. Set when a change is decomposed from a larger feature (e.g. feature-stream-core → parent_feature='feature-stream'). Null for standalone changes. Redundant with name-prefix derivation but provides explicit registration for edge cases.
